parent_group_reconciliation.interpretation: Existing explicit parent links are mechanically resolved and group-consistent if lists are empty; semantic appropriateness is not verified by that mechanical check.

Existing splits are not endorsed as leakage-safe until candidate semantic links are adjudicated and a fresh split is generated.

No labels or model behavior are adjudicated by this family workstream.
